description:
You are a systems engineer performing a post-migration audit of traceability links in a ReqView requirements project. After a recent document format migration, some satisfaction traceability links in the SRS document have become corrupted — they point to non-existent NEEDS requirement IDs.

Your task is to find and repair the broken satisfaction links in the SRS document. The following SRS requirements are known to have broken satisfaction links that need repair:

1. SRS-72 (in File Operations > Import section) — should satisfy NEEDS-27 but currently points to an invalid target
2. SRS-106 (in Edit Document > Document Structure section) — should satisfy NEEDS-17 but currently points to an invalid target
3. SRS-132 (in Edit Document > Comments section) — should satisfy NEEDS-24 but currently points to an invalid target
4. SRS-137 (in Edit Document > Traceability Links section) — should satisfy NEEDS-21 but currently points to an invalid target

For each broken link, delete the invalid traceability link and create a new correct satisfaction link to the specified NEEDS requirement.

Login credentials: The application is already open with the project loaded.
